# E-M5 III 1.7 Live ND live-view simulation (OM-5 port)

Test builds show the Live ND blur in live view, averaged by image-engine job 12.

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Oly Firmware Notes and Mods (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** unpublished test builds (to 2026-11-17)

With LV Simulation on, live view averages up to 240 recent frames with the OM-5's job 12, as on the OM-5, and restarts on shutter changes and camera movement.

**Availability:** experimental branch. **Implementation basis:** reported.

## Supporting observations

- [E-M5 III 1.7: Live ND live-view preview from test builds](../evidence/em5-iii-live-nd-preview.md) — physical camera; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.

- Movement restart thresholds are still being tuned.
